cohort: A single patient born at 37 weeks and 2 days of gestation diagnosed with biliary and duodenal atresia who presented with false-negative hepatobiliary scintigraphy results.
finding: Hepatobiliary scintigraphy can yield false-negative results in patients with biliary atresia, as evidenced by this case where the gallbladder was visualized and duodeno-gastric reflux was noted despite fibrous obliteration of the common bile duct.
